_about: How state-bill-watcher.yml gets each state's current-session bills, set from the 2026-11-13 trial runs. source: scraper = Open States' open-source scraper run here; api = left to the app server's Open States API watcher (small free quota) until a scraper can run. split: scrape each chamber in its own job (states that took over ~2 h, or a rate-limited site). rpm: requests per minute to the legislature's site. secret: the repo secret the scraper needs (the state's own API key); without it the state falls back to the API watcher.

in._note: Indiana General Assembly API key: docs.api.iga.in.gov

il._note: ilga.gov answers 403 to GitHub and to a home connection alike

tx._note: Texas Legislature's FTP resets GitHub's connections, even at 20 rpm
